caption: The drawing depicts a garment resembling a loose-fitting, short-sleeved robe or smock. The garment is rendered in light, pale blue or off-white tones, with vertical lines suggesting pleats or fine stripes running throughout the fabric. The short sleeves are wide and also pleated, giving a puffed appearance. All visible edges of the garment, including the sleeves, front opening, and lower hem, are bordered with a narrow band that features small red floral patterns with green detailing interspersed along the length. The front of the garment is open from the neckline downwards, secured at the top by a small round button or clasp. The background is plain and unadorned, and the drawing style emphasizes delicate and precise detailing.
title: Boy's Coat
